body:
Concrete low-ambiguity shapes from a second read of 99fd15e, offered to speed the amendment:

1. Replace ModelInputObserved(value, checksum) with a redacted observation value whose only public field is the checksum and whose package-private factory derives it from the raw model input. The raw string remains available only long enough for the equality check; it never enters decisions, equality, toString, or receipt material.

2. Wrap sidecar acceptance in a private-constructed AcceptedAlignmentSidecar carrying dialect plus providerNodeIds, with its checksum derived from those exact fields. ParserAttemptDecision carries that one value and receipt rendering delegates to its canonical material. An equally good smaller shape is to drop the checksum parameter entirely and render dialect plus ordered node IDs directly. Either removes the independent-pair door while retaining node IDs as chief required.

3. Make the runtime failure fact itself validated, then let ParserFailure wrap that fact instead of mirroring four forgeable payloads. A sealed/private-constructor ParserSetupFailure companion can expose factories that require nonempty missing vectors, current not in nonempty supported, required greater than available with nonnegative quantities, nonblank Custom namespace/label, nonblank Dependency name, and nonblank invalid-field path. ParserFailure.RuntimeUnavailable(reason) then cannot widen the state again. This also closes empty RuntimeDependencyUnpinned and blank InvalidRuntime, not only the three new cases.

I am not prescribing names and will review any equivalent proof. No edit made; tracked action request remains open.
